info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Asset Details API
info.description: The Customer Asset Details API enables users to retrieve comprehensive information about specific assets owned by customers. By providing a customer ID and an asset ID, this API allows businesses to access detailed asset data, which can inform service decisions and enhance customer support. Typical consumers include customer service representatives, asset management systems, and analytics tools. This API is essential for organizations seeking to improve their asset tracking and management capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve assets for a specific customer.
get.description: Fetches the list of assets associated with the customer identified by CUST-100045. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about each asset, including their status, type, and any relevant metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to retrieve specific asset details for the customer with ID CUST-100045 and asset resource ID RES-100045. It is essential to provide valid identifiers to ensure the correct resource is accessed.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested asset details.

GetCustomerAssetsCUST100045RES100045Requ.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the asset details related to customer CUST-100045.
